target.title: policy: repair required deny tool findings
target.body:
## Summary
- Add required-deny automatic repairs for Policy doctor findings.
- Merge missing required tool ids into the exact reported `tools.deny` or agent `tools.deny` config path.
- Keep the Policy `workspaceRepairs=true` opt-in inherited from #99690.
- Skip scoped findings when the only available write target is inherited root `tools.deny`.
- Correct required-deny fix metadata so public Policy recommendations point at OpenClaw config paths: `tools.deny` and `agents.list[].tools.deny`.

## Stack
- Builds on merged #99690 (`policy: repair automatic narrowing findings`).
- Current head: `b1542f3d0f98d701ed60a39f9e7d759b8cabddf4`.
- Still draft until ClawSweeper refreshes and maintainer review is clear.

## Validation
- `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts --reporter=dot` passed: 3 Vitest shards / 313 tests.
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.extensions.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions.tsbuildinfo` passed.
- `OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/policy/src/doctor/fix-metadata.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts` passed.
- `node --import tsx scripts/check-policy-config-coverage.ts --check --json` passed with no unclassified, unmatched, or stale monitored paths.
- `git diff --check` passed.

## Real behavior proof
Behavior or issue addressed: `doctor --fix` repairs required deny-tool Policy findings by adding missing required tools to the reported deny-list config path, while preserving existing entries and keeping dry-run non-mutating.

Real environment tested: Windows PowerShell in `C:\src\openclaw-fork` on refreshed PR head `b1542f3d0f98d701ed60a39f9e7d759b8cabddf4` after merging current `upstream/main` containing #99690.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts --reporter=dot`
2. `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.extensions.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions.tsbuildinfo`
3. `OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/policy/src/doctor/fix-metadata.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts`
4. `node --import tsx scripts/check-policy-config-coverage.ts --check --json`
5. `git diff --check`

Evidence after fix: The focused policy tests include `dry-runs required tool deny repairs without mutating config`, `repairs required agent workspace deny tool findings`, `skips scoped required deny repairs that would mutate root tools deny`, and `points required-deny repair metadata at OpenClaw deny config paths`. The targeted run passed 313 tests across policy doctor metadata/register, core repair flow, and SDK surface tooling.

Observed result after fix: Required deny repairs add only the missing required tool ids to the reported deny array, leave existing deny entries intact, skip inherited root deny writes for scoped policy findings, and report no remaining finding for repaired agent workspace denies. Public Policy fix metadata now points required-deny consumers at `tools.deny` / `agents.list[].tools.deny`, matching the repair target.

What was not tested: A full packaged/dev CLI `openclaw doctor --fix` smoke was attempted with isolated `OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH` and `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, but local Windows dev CLI startup did not return before a 240s timeout. No live provider run or live LLM call was run. Targeted `pnpm exec oxfmt --check ...` was also attempted locally but timed out before producing a result; `git diff --check` and targeted oxlint passed.
